# Jamie Interior Designs

Website for Jamie Interior Designs: modern gypsum ceilings, interiors, space planning, design concepts, painting and decoration, colour selection and decor artwork.

Live site: https://alexmutegi12.github.io/jamie-interior-designs/

## Structure
- `index.html` the whole site (HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file)
- `images/` project photos, logo and favicon
- `404.html` page shown for broken links
- `robots.txt` and `sitemap.xml` for search engines

## Before launch, replace
- Phone, WhatsApp number (`254700000000`), email and address in `index.html`
- Social media links in the menu
- Portfolio tiles with real photos from `images/`
- About text, years of experience and project count

## Update the site
Edit a file on GitHub (pencil icon) or push changes with Git. GitHub Pages refreshes in 1 to 2 minutes.
